text:
Unification Minister Chung Dong-young was set to meet U.S. Ambassador Michelle Steel and U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson on Friday, the ministry said.
It will be Chung's first official meeting with Steel, who arrived here in late July as Washington's top envoy to Seoul. The ministry confirmed last month that it was arranging the meeting.
Since her arrival, Steel has met a series of South Korean ministers, beginning with Foreign Minister Cho Hyun in early August.
That she had yet to meet Chung more than two months into her tenure, however, had fueled speculation that the United States was displeased with Chung's alleged leak of classified information on North Korea.
The speculation centered on Chung's remarks in March about a third uranium enrichment facility in North Korea, which the U.S. government regards as classified information. Chung has said the information was already in the public domain.
Chung and Steel are widely expected to discuss ways to resume dialogue with Pyongyang as well as Seoul's push for peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula. They will meet at Chung's office in the government complex in Seoul.
Chung will then travel to the inter-Korean border village of Panmunjom later in the day to meet Brunson, who also leads the United Nations Command and South Korea-U.S. Combined Forces Command.
It will also be the first official meeting between the two. Brunson took command in South Korea in December 2024, and Chung became unification minister in July 2025.
